title: The Brave New Start
summary: When his family moves to a new town, Marcus faces his fears about friendship, discovers his own strength, and learns that being courageous means taking risks and accepting help from others.

pages.text: Marcus felt nervous about the moving day. His heart was pounding.
pages.scene: Marcus standing in front of a moving truck with boxes around him, looking anxious and uncertain about change.

pages.text: He was leaving his hometown. All his friends were staying.
pages.scene: Marcus looking out a car window as his neighborhood disappears behind them, emotional and struggling.

pages.text: His new house felt empty and unfamiliar. The rooms seemed too quiet.
pages.scene: Marcus walking through a large, mostly empty house with boxes stacked in corners, sunlight creating long shadows.

pages.text: "This will be different," his mother said cheerfully. Marcus wasn't certain.
pages.scene: Marcus's mother smiling encouragingly while unpacking, but Marcus looking unconvinced and withdrawn.

pages.text: Starting a new school felt terrifying. Marcus dressed slowly and anxiously.
pages.scene: Marcus putting on his school uniform in front of a mirror, his face showing worry and apprehension.

pages.text: His teachers were friendly and helpful. Still, Marcus felt confused.
pages.scene: Teachers warmly greeting students while Marcus sits at a desk, looking lost among unfamiliar faces.

pages.text: At lunch, nobody was sitting near him. Marcus felt lonely.
pages.scene: Marcus sitting alone at a lunch table with his tray, watching other students eating and laughing together.

pages.text: A boy named Darius stopped. "Can I sit down?" he asked politely.
pages.scene: A friendly boy named Darius approaching Marcus's table with his lunch tray and an inviting smile.

pages.text: Marcus was surprised. "Yes!" he said hopefully.
pages.scene: Marcus's face lighting up with unexpected joy as Darius sits down across from him.

pages.text: Darius asked questions. He was genuinely interested in Marcus's story.
pages.scene: Darius leaning forward attentively, listening carefully while Marcus talks about his old home.

pages.text: "Moving was probably frightening," Darius said thoughtfully. Marcus nodded.
pages.scene: Darius showing empathy and understanding, validating Marcus's difficult feelings about the move.

pages.text: "My family moved last year. I felt exactly the same way," Darius explained.
pages.scene: Darius sharing his own experience, creating a moment of connection and understanding between the two boys.

pages.text: Marcus felt less isolated. Someone understood him completely.
pages.scene: Marcus and Darius laughing together, the tension visibly leaving Marcus's shoulders.

pages.text: After lunch, Darius introduced Marcus to other students. They seemed interesting.
pages.scene: Darius proudly introducing Marcus to a group of friendly kids who welcome him with genuine interest.

pages.text: A girl named Sofia showed him the library. She explained everything clearly.
pages.scene: Sofia walking Marcus through the school library, pointing out resources and smiling encouragingly.

pages.text: "You're going to like it here," Sofia said confidently. Marcus began believing.
pages.scene: Sofia's confidence and kindness inspiring Marcus to consider that maybe this new place could be good.

pages.text: He joined the after-school science club. He was nervous but determined.
pages.scene: Marcus sitting with other students around a lab table, carefully setting up an experiment.

pages.text: The students welcomed him warmly. They celebrated his ideas.
pages.scene: Marcus presenting an idea to the group, everyone listening respectfully and offering encouraging feedback.

pages.text: By autumn, Marcus had wonderful friends. He felt genuinely happy.
pages.scene: Marcus with Darius and Sofia walking through the school hallway, all three laughing and looking comfortable together.

pages.text: He realized something powerful. Being brave meant stepping forward even when frightened.
pages.scene: Marcus looking confidently forward, visualizing himself growing stronger and more capable than before.

skills_focus: Recognizing cause and effect in relationships
